name: veta-trading-platform
description: VETA Trading Platform — real-time market simulation with algorithmic trading strategies.

scripts.typecheck: deno task check && cd frontend && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: deno task test && cd frontend && npm run test:unit -- --run
scripts.test:e2e: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run test:ui
scripts.fallow:audit: npm run fallow:backend:audit && npm run fallow:frontend:audit
scripts.fallow:health: npm run fallow:backend:health && npm run fallow:frontend:health
scripts.fallow:dead-code: npm run fallow:backend:dead-code && npm run fallow:frontend:dead-code
scripts.quality:git: git diff --check && git diff --cached --check && ! git status --short --untracked-files=normal | grep -q .
